dct_description_sm: Yemen administrative level 0-2 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset version 01. This dataset is structured into 2 levels: - Admin 1: 22 Governorate - Admin 2: 335 District Dates associated with this dataset: - 23 December 2024: dataset reviewed for accuracy and completeness - 22 November 2019: valid for use by the humanitarian community - 09 October 2023: last edit to the dataset before publishing - 09 October 2023: boundaries created by the source Contributed by [OCHA Yemen](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-yemen). Quality assured, configured, and published by [OCHA Field Information Services (FIS)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-fiss) and [HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hdx). Part of the dataset: [Global Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-global)
